reuse.why: Uses the shared link.ensureAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and syncAccount, but copies the upgrade-or-insert account body and the download function instead of factoring them (and passes a bare institution string where findOrCreateBank expects an Institution).

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount/linkEnableBankingAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadEnableBankingTransactions.

placement.why: Handler, download function, server URL, provider list and account type are each added where the other providers' equivalents live.

scope.why: Only the server-side pieces needed for the new provider are added.

maintainability.why: It follows the established per-provider pattern, so it is easy to read, but adds a sixth copy of the linking flow that any future change to linking must touch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing link helpers and syncAccount dispatch; the copied body has no shared abstraction in this tree to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of the link flow and transaction download are open, not renamed or reshaped.
